title: Approaching television and WTTW
summary: After the Daily News piece, Hodes asks about television. A man offers a chance at WTTW.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: 'Tell It Like It Is.' And so I met Mr. Keegan or Hogan or -- and I asked him if he could open a door for me on television. See, I tried radio and Studs tried for me, but for me to do a program on radio, no, there's no place for me, unless you go out and get a sponsor.

So I couldn't do that, so I had to give up. I'm not capable of getting sponsors. So I tried to break the door down, and he says, well, maybe I could do something for you on Channel 11, WTTW. It was on on the South Side at that time. I went out there, and I auditioned. I played along and told the story of jazz as I knew it.
